InfoGeometry.Physics.ChiralPoincareSouriauBridge.det_pauliMomentum (P : FourMomentum) :
  det (pauliMomentum P) = minkowskiSq P
InfoGeometry.Physics.ChiralPoincareSouriauBridge.momentum_from_supercharges (S : ChiralSUSYMomentum) :
  momentumSpinorFromSupercharges S = pauliMomentum S.P
InfoGeometry.Physics.ChiralPoincareSouriauBridge.det_spinorOuter_zero (lam mu : Fin 2 → ℂ) :
  det (spinorOuter lam mu) = 0
InfoGeometry.Physics.ChiralPoincareSouriauBridge.souriau_beta_norm (T γ vx vy vz : ℂ)
  (hγ : γ ^ 2 * (1 - vx ^ 2 - vy ^ 2 - vz ^ 2) = 1) :
  have β := { b0 := γ / T, bx := γ * vx / T, bY := γ * vy / T, bz := γ * vz / T };
  β.b0 ^ 2 - β.bx ^ 2 - β.bY ^ 2 - β.bz ^ 2 = (T ^ 2)⁻¹
InfoGeometry.Physics.ChiralPoincareSouriauBridge.chiral_poincare_souriau_bridge_synthesis (S : ChiralSUSYMomentum) :
  momentumSpinorFromSupercharges S = pauliMomentum S.P ∧
    det (pauliMomentum S.P) = minkowskiSq S.P ∧
      recoverE (momentumSpinorFromSupercharges S) = S.P.E ∧
        recoverPx (momentumSpinorFromSupercharges S) = S.P.px ∧
          recoverPy (momentumSpinorFromSupercharges S) = S.P.py ∧ recoverPz (momentumSpinorFromSupercharges S) = S.P.pz
